integrity: The semantic reduction was reconstructed directly from the published team-semantics proof and combined with the infinite Hall theorem for families of finite sets. The bundled checker supplies finite replay evidence but does not replace the infinite proof. Targeted database and literature searches did not locate an equivalent team-semantic Hall formulation.
scientific_limitations: The finite Hall-certificate equivalence assumes every row of the team relation is finite and gives no uniform bound on certificate size. The boundary example only rules out dropping that hypothesis from this specific finite-subfamily criterion; broader infinite matching criteria are not addressed.
title: Hall certificates for the inquisitive finiteness formula on row-finite teams
